title: Brill Town Hall

[[image:Brill Town Hall.jpg|thumb|Brill Town Hall]]
The '''Brill Town Hall''' is the most prominent structure in the town of [[Brill]] in central [[Tirisfal Glades]]. [[Magistrate Sevren]] leads the town from his podium, issuing orders and tasks to willing [[Forsaken]] subjects. The town hall is also notable because it is the only town hall in the realms known to be run by the [[Forsaken|Undead]].
